verdict.rationale: The only pricing evidence is a community comment confirming Steel publishes pricing on both a pricing page and in its docs. The same comment reports the two disagree ($59 vs $99 for the developer tier), which undermines transparency. There is no first-party pricing evidence in the pack, and nothing documents rate or concurrency limits. Missing for 10: first-party per-session/per-browser-hour pricing details, consistent pricing across sources, documented rate limits, documented concurrency limits.
